summary: Centralized masternode-rental yield platform established around 2019 that suspended deposits and withdrawals in October 2022 and moved customer balances into a prolonged restructuring, NFT claim, and proposed YieldNodes Pro transition.
what_happened: YieldNodes accepted customer crypto into a managed masternode and staking model. First-party statements say deposits and withdrawals were suspended in October 2022 after exchange-account restrictions and liquidity pressure, and that the operator began a restructuring tied to DECENOMY assets. The operator later distributed account-linked NFTs and proposed a future YieldNodes Pro platform, while affected investors organized separate recovery efforts. The original account balances, NFT rights, underlying asset claims, and any future-platform rights remain distinct and unresolved.
uncertainty_notes: The exact 2019 launch day was not identified. The immediate and ultimate causes of the 2022 suspension, asset backing, legal ownership of underlying assets, value of account-linked NFTs, enforceability of repurchase language, recovery rate, and launch prospects for YieldNodes Pro remain contested or unverified.
notes: Status is restructuring rather than operations-ended because the operator continues publishing updates and describes a proposed successor model, but ordinary deposits and withdrawals have not resumed in the reviewed evidence.

summary: Centralized crypto yield platform founded as Cake DeFi in 2019, rebranded to Bake in 2023, and reduced to account maintenance and USD withdrawals after suspending crypto-asset services on 15 April 2026 for MiCA alignment.
what_happened: Cake DeFi originally provided retail access to staking, institutional lending, liquidity mining, and later Savings and DeFi-powered Lending products. The retail business rebranded to Bake in June 2023. In March 2026 the operator announced an indefinite suspension of crypto-asset services, and from 15 April 2026 remaining crypto balances were converted to USD, new crypto deposits and accounts were stopped, and existing accounts became withdrawal-only under a custodial arrangement. The reviewed evidence does not establish completion of every withdrawal or uniform treatment of illiquid assets.
uncertainty_notes: The exact 2019 launch day was not identified. Historical Cake DeFi products used different strategies and terms. The reviewed April 2026 terms establish a withdrawal-only USD state, but do not prove that every customer completed withdrawal or that every illiquid asset retained recoverable value.
notes: Status is limited because the platform and accounts remain available for maintenance and USD withdrawals, while crypto-asset and yield functionality is blocked.
